correctness.rationale: The generator has the stated unique full-rank Bloch stationary state. Its mixed-qubit SLD QFI algebra is exact, and differentiation yields 2uP divided by a strictly positive denominator. Descartes sign rule gives exactly one positive zero for all t>=0 because P has coefficients ++++---, P(0)>0 and leading coefficient negative; this uniquely maximizes QFI. Exact factorizations at t=0 and t=u^2-1 establish critical equality and strict bound; implicit function and bracketing of scaled positive roots yield the asymptotic limits. The packaged symbolic and 45 independent quadrature/SLD comparisons have been executed successfully.

value.rationale: A single-qubit stationary frequency sensor has a nontrivial, physically motivated conflict between dephasing at small reset rates and information destruction by too-frequent preparation. A complete unique-rate theorem with strict lower frequency/dephasing bound, exact zero-detuning optimum and sharp large-detuning optimum and information scale gives a concrete design boundary beyond routine evaluation of the steady state. It does not overclaim rate-normalized sensing, feedback, or practical implementation.
